tv-smile.name: Samuel Bellini
tv-smile.epithet: the kid with the television smile

brawler-king.name: Harold Young
brawler-king.epithet: the brawler from the slums of somewhere

skull-king.name: Dwight Holloway
skull-king.epithet: the shaven-skulled champion nobody would fight

reform-kid.name: Jimmy Turner
reform-kid.epithet: the kid from the reform school

fightOffers.pitch: A fair fight on paper. The kind careers are made of.

fighter.statement: I don’t want to just fight. I want a belt, and I want it here. I’m going to be a champion. I just need somebody who sees it too.
fighter.ceilingRead: Handled right, he could surprise some people down the line.

fighter.statement: I won’t be a problem in your gym. I just want to work. I know I’ve got a lot to learn. I’m ready to listen. Whatever you need me to do, I’ll do it without complaining.
fighter.ceilingRead: You’ve seen a hundred like him. Most don’t last a year.

fighter.statement: People keep telling me what I can’t do. I’m tired of hearing it. I’ve been overlooked my whole life. I’m used to it. It just makes me work. I don’t need you to believe in me. I need you to train me.
fighter.ceilingRead: Bodies in the gym have their place. You don’t see a future in this one.

history.text: You signed the lease and put the name on the door: The Kitchen.

recentLog.text: The door is open. The bags are hung. Now you wait and see who walks in.
